# White Cloud — Website Design for NZ Small Businesses
# https://wcloud.nz

## About
White Cloud is a web design service based in Christchurch, New Zealand. Founded by Jay, it helps New Zealand small businesses get online with affordable, professional, AI-optimised websites. No technical knowledge required from the client.

## What We Do
- Design and build websites for small businesses across New Zealand
- Specialise in AI-optimised websites that are readable and recommendable by AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google
- Provide monthly website care plans for ongoing maintenance

## Services & Pricing (NZD, one-off payments, all prices EXCLUDE GST)

**Cloud One — NZ$299 + GST** (NZ$343.85 incl. GST)
For sole traders and new businesses needing a simple online presence.
- Up to 3 pages (Home, About, Contact)
- Mobile-friendly design
- Contact form + Google Maps embed
- Basic SEO setup
- Delivered in 5–7 business days

**Cloud Plus — NZ$699 + GST** (NZ$803.85 incl. GST) *(Most Popular)*
A full website to showcase services and build customer trust.
- Up to 6 pages
- Full SEO setup + Google Business integration
- Services page, testimonials section, contact form + click-to-call
- Delivered in 7–10 business days

**Cloud Pro — NZ$1,099 + GST** (NZ$1,263.85 incl. GST)
Premium presence for businesses that want to stand out.
- Up to 10 pages
- Blog or news section, gallery or portfolio
- Advanced contact and booking forms
- Full SEO + sitemap
- Priority delivery in 5–7 business days

## Peelie (White Cloud's own app)
Peelie is a digital loyalty stamp card app for cafés, bakeries and eateries in Christchurch (Ōtautahi), New Zealand, made by White Cloud. It replaces paper coffee and loyalty cards.
- Status: in beta testing with local Christchurch shops; coming soon to the App Store (iPhone and iPad). Not on Android yet.
- How it works for customers: at the counter, tap the Sticker button to show a QR code; staff scan it with the shop's own phone or iPad and a sticker lands on the card. Snap a photo of your food and it becomes the sticker (or pick a ready-made one). Fill the card to get the shop's reward, such as a free coffee. Every sticker is kept in a food diary.
- Free for customers.
- For shop owners: design your own card (colour, logo or photo, reward, stickers per card, minimum spend), staff check in once a shift with their own PIN, post ads and offers (notifications to opted-in customers, at most two a week), plain-English analytics, and a printable window poster with QR code. No scanners or till changes needed.
- Built-in anti-cheat: only signed-in staff on the shop's device can give stickers, one sticker per customer per shop every 3 hours, a shift log, and alerts for unusual activity.
- Privacy: shops see a customer code and stickers, not the customer's name, unless the customer switches on sharing for that shop. Location stays on the phone. Data is stored with Supabase in Sydney, Australia. Customers can delete their account in the app (NZ Privacy Act 2020).
- Shops interested in Peelie: email kiaora@wcloud.nz or call 021 854 847.
- Peelie page: https://wcloud.nz/peelieapp
- Help and FAQ: https://wcloud.nz/peelieapp/support
- Privacy policy: https://wcloud.nz/peelieapp/privacy
